searchText: Tried the Hosted Test interface [here](https://ceremony.ethereum.org/) and I've been re-directed 4 times when trying to LogIn with Ethereum by signing the required messages. Not sure if that is the expected behaviour, but the app finally seems to be stucked at https://ceremony.ethereum.org/#/double_sign Here I leave the console error of Firefox: ``` Uncaught (in promise) TypeError: can't access property 0, s is null <anonymous> doubleSign.tsx:71 l doubleSign.tsx:148 ``` <CarlBeek> which wallets are you using and are you using the same account for the sign-in phase and binding phase? Same one for both. Maybe I missed reading something and need to be different?? I signed through SIWE and used Metamask to sign the messages as Web3Provider <nicoserranop> > <nicoserranop> I will check it out right away 😊 (re @kzg_ceremony_bot: <CPerezz.eth> Here I leave the console error of Firefox: ``` Uncaught (in promise) TypeError: can't access property 0, s is null <anonymous> doubleSign.tsx:71 l doubleSign.tsx:148 ```) <nicoserranop> > <nicoserranop> I think I found the error, the patch has been pushed to the main branch and I feel that the deployment pipline might take aroound 10 minutes.
